title: Call 1: overdraft fees during a hospital stay (Abdul's script)

cast.agent: Abdul plays Sam, a Thistle Bank colleague

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thistle Bank, Sam speaking, how can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I've been charged overdraft fees three times this month and I'm really not happy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Can I take your name and date of birth, and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Ellen Hart, 4th of March 1985, 12 Hill Street.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks Ellen. Yes, I can see three £25 fees.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I was in hospital for two weeks and couldn't sort my account out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Oh right. Don't worry, I'm sure we'll refund all of that for you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Someone will be in touch. Anything else?

expected.notes: C1: dissatisfaction expressed, never logged as a complaint. C2: hospital stay, no support offered. C3: refund promised. S1: 'someone will be in touch' is vague. S4/S5 judgement calls: dismissive 'Oh right', no ownership.
